purpose: Evaluate useful discovery and tool selection separately from business workflow correctness. No ranking or recall improvement has been measured.
setup: Use a dedicated populated demo workspace, install/connect the reviewed candidate, record host and catalog version. An unbranded prompt with ambiguous data source may require clarification. Do not force tool use merely to improve recall.

cases.prompt: In TrolyPage, find Review Customer A and summarize the latest conversation. Read only.
cases.expected: Use available customer search/conversation tools within the connected demo workspace; no send.

cases.prompt: Use TrolyPage to check the price and stock for SKU TLP-REVIEW-MUG.
cases.expected: Use product lookup tools; no order write.

cases.prompt: Summarize the latest conversation with Review Customer A in the connected workspace.
cases.expected: Resolve the data source if ambiguous; otherwise use the connected TrolyPage customer/conversation tools.

cases.prompt: Look up the price and stock for SKU TLP-REVIEW-MUG in my shop catalog.
cases.expected: Resolve source where needed; use authoritative product lookup, not invented prices.

cases.prompt: Prepare an order for two units of TLP-REVIEW-MUG for Review Customer A, for shop review. Do not take payment or create shipping.
cases.expected: Resolve customer/product IDs, create a pending order only as authorized, respect approvals and read back state.

cases.prompt: Compare sales for the last 30 days with the previous period in this workspace.
cases.expected: Use the sales report with aligned filters/timezone; no unnecessary export.

cases.prompt: Save an unscheduled draft for the connected test Facebook account. Do not publish.
cases.expected: Resolve real social account, obtain or draft approved content and create only an unscheduled draft when supported. No publication.

cases.prompt: Add an internal note for Review Customer A to follow up after the demo. Do not message the customer.
cases.expected: Resolve customer and add internal CRM note only; do not send a message.
Answer from general knowledge; no workspace tool needed.

cases.prompt: Write a fun Monday caption without using any data or brand information.
cases.expected: Draft text in the conversation; do not call paid generation, retrieve private data or create a post.

cases.prompt: Find the latest email in my Gmail.
cases.expected: Use a legitimately authorized mail tool or explain missing access; do not route through TrolyPage integration operations as a workaround.

cases.prompt: I do not have a TrolyPage account. Explain what the product does and how to get started.
cases.expected: Explain product and onboarding from verified public material; do not attempt private business tools or claim an account was created.
